integrity: Exact algebraic proof with reproducible pure-Python finite-field and tangent checks; computations are supporting checks, not substitutes for infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Algebraically closed characteristic-three fields only; fixed one-parameter Dwork quartic pencil; does not classify other curves or pencils. Exact relative line scheme, distinct from individual-fiber reduced Fano scheme. Possible priority overlap in unindexed or uninspected sources.
title: The length-176 relative Fano scheme of the characteristic-three Dwork quartic pencil
